title: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO (Xbox Series X)

comparisons.notes: New condition at $39.99, UPC 722674240574, NTSC, Xbox Series X/S, matching the Woot item.

writeup: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO for Xbox Series X is new on Woot for $14.99, while Gameware charges $39.99 for a new copy of the same standard edition (UPC 722674240574). It is the arena fighter in the Budokai Tenkaichi tradition with a huge roster and destructible stages. Woot shows only one left, limit one per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from Woot offer data, confirmed by the price checker as the Xbox Series X standard edition (UPC 722674240574, model 24057).
